classdef.name: LinkedStoryOption
classdef.shortdesc: The link options for a linked story.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the LinkedStoryOption (a Application, Document, Story or XmlStory).

property.name: updateWhileSaving
property.shortdesc: If true, the linked story will be updated while saving.

property.name: warnOnUpdateOfEditedStory
property.shortdesc: If true, a warning will be shown if the update link operation will override local edits.

property.name: removeForcedLineBreaks
property.shortdesc: If true, forced line breaks will be removed during story creation or update.

property.name: applyStyleMappings
property.shortdesc: If true, style mappings will be applied during linked story creation or update.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the LinkedStoryOption.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
